title: UNION
description:
## UNION
UNION combines the results of two SELECT statements into one result set. The columns must match in number and type.
```sql
SELECT name FROM customers
UNION
SELECT name FROM employees;
```
`UNION` removes duplicates automatically. If you want to keep duplicates, use `UNION ALL`.


---
## Assignment:
BWS has two tables: `active_servers` and `retired_servers`. Combine them into one list showing all server names and their status.
setupCode: CREATE TABLE active_servers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, status TEXT); CREATE TABLE retired_servers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, status TEXT); INSERT INTO active_servers VALUES (1, 'prod-1', 'running'), (2, 'prod-2', 'running'), (3, 'staging', 'stopped'); INSERT INTO retired_servers VALUES (1, 'old-prod', 'decommissioned'), (2, 'legacy-db', 'decommissioned'), (3, 'staging', 'decommissioned');
expectedOutput:
name | status
legacy-db | decommissioned
old-prod | decommissioned
prod-1 | running
prod-2 | running
staging | decommissioned
staging | stopped
